notes:
Open on purpose: a Haredi Torah application, and video could not be separated from audio by host.

Watched on a device: the API runs over clear HTTP on streaming.kolhalashon.com (the base URL is chosen at runtime; www.kolhalashon.com and kol.kolhl.com are in the code too), iPhone/GetMediaURL.aspx?FileID=N&FileType=audio|video answers audio with an https URL under /mp3/ and video with an http URL under /mp4/, both on www.kolhalashon.com. Live plays in a WebView with JW Player (ssl.p.jwpcdn.com, prd.jwpltx.com) from streaming.kolhalashon.com:443; older live streams use port 1935 for audio and video alike. A video only block would need a rule on the clear HTTP path, which the filter does not do.
